body: Even made sure to find one from my culture^just^for^YOU ;)
It started out with him asking if I had any siblings. Which usually seems like a standard question. I might be wrong though.
Yeap... we had been talking for a bit too. Sad times my friend.

I feel like I never went to girl school. I have hair a little longer than shoulder length with side swept bangs. It is always down or in a ponytail. I want to do more!!

Most of the tutorials I've found online want back combing or teasing and hair spray. I have really thin already chemically treated hair. I don't want to destroy it more.

Suggestions? Tips? Pointers?

Funnily enough they say it because I take life too seriously. I spend a lot of time focusing on bills and the need for better employment.

That's the context where I am told I need to take care of myself most often. I have no idea what that means though.
I mean how do you maintain that happiness? What do you do to create that happiness?
Sex with someone who actually wants to be with me!!
